method: Editorial source-context review; no Gemini verifier, hands-on product experiment or human publication approval. reviewFocus.en: Review included-credit allocation, overage policy and metered budgets together. Confirm current API and UI availability before changing controls; this source review does not measure actual savings.

en.title: Copilot credit pools: included usage and additional spending

claims.text: GitHub announced cost-center AI credit pools for Copilot Business and Enterprise on Enterprise Cloud. At announcement time, configuration was available through the REST API, while settings-UI management was still planned.

evidence.quote: This is available through the REST API today. Management in the cost center settings UI is coming soon.
This is available for Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise on GitHub Enterprise Cloud

claims.text: The pool cap limits a cost center’s draw from enterprise-wide included credits; a cost-center budget governs metered charges after the included pool is exhausted. These controls cover different spending phases and can be combined.

evidence.quote: An AI credit pool is separate from a cost center budget.
A cost center budget governs the metered phase, capping charges after the pool is exhausted.

claims.text: GitHub calculates the pool limit from assigned licenses. At the cap, enterprises can block further included usage or allow additional spend when overages are permitted, so the pool is not automatically a hard cap on all charges.

evidence.quote: GitHub calculates the pool limit automatically from the licenses assigned to that cost center
block further included usage or let it continue as additional spend if your enterprise allows overages.

evidence.quote: This is available through the REST API today. Management in the cost center settings UI is coming soon.

evidence.quote: An AI credit pool is separate from a cost center budget.

en.title: Cost-center user budgets: billing UI and membership scope

claims.text: GitHub announced that Enterprise Cloud administrators could create cost-center user-level budgets in the billing UI, exposing controls previously available through the REST API. This describes a management interface expansion.

evidence.quote: This feature is available for GitHub Enterprise Cloud.
This gives you the same per-user AI credit budget controls that were previously only available through the REST API.

claims.text: The configured per-user budget applies to the cost center’s enterprise teams or individual users and follows membership changes automatically. This is a shared budget setting applied per member, not a separately negotiated limit for every person.

evidence.quote: set one per-user budget for that cost center, and have it automatically apply to everyone in it.
As membership changes, budget coverage stays in sync

claims.text: GitHub은 Enterprise Cloud 관리자가 결제 화면에서 비용 센터 사용자별 예산을 만들 수 있다고 공지했다. 기존 REST API 통제를 화면으로 제공하는 관리 인터페이스 확장이다.

evidence.quote: This feature is available for GitHub Enterprise Cloud.
This gives you the same per-user AI credit budget controls that were previously only available through the REST API.

evidence.quote: set one per-user budget for that cost center, and have it automatically apply to everyone in it.
As membership changes, budget coverage stays in sync

reviewFocus.en: Test native builds and dependency sources before upgrading, and review script allowlists rather than enabling everything. Verify current publishing support for your CI provider; a schedule announcement is not proof that every registry action has already changed.
reviewFocus.ko: 업그레이드 전 네이티브 빌드·의존성 출처를 검증하고 전체 허용 대신 스크립트 허용 목록을 검토할 것을 제안합니다. CI 제공자의 현재 게시 지원을 확인해야 하며 일정 공지만으로 모든 레지스트리 동작의 변경 완료를 단정하면 안 됩니다.

en.title: npm installation defaults and staged token restrictions

claims.text: The npm 12 announcement makes dependency lifecycle scripts and implicit node-gyp builds opt-in, and defaults Git and remote-URL dependency resolution to none unless explicitly allowed. These are installation defaults, not a guarantee that installed code is harmless.

evidence.quote: Dependency lifecycle scripts (i.e., preinstall , install , postinstall ) and implicit node-gyp builds no longer run unless explicitly allowed.
--allow-git defaults to none
--allow-remote defaults to none

claims.text: The same notice planned removal of sensitive management actions from npm 2FA-bypass tokens for early 2026-08. It separately targeted direct-publish restrictions for around 2027-01, with trusted publishing or human-approved staged publishing as migration paths.

evidence.quote: We expect this change to take effect in early August 2026.
We expect this change to take effect around January 2027.
move automated publishing to trusted publishing (OIDC) or staged publishing with a human approval step

followUp.text: The 2026-07-31 follow-up says npm 2FA-bypass granular access tokens can no longer perform sensitive management actions and requires an interactive 2FA challenge. It explicitly excludes GitHub personal access tokens, GitHub App tokens and GITHUB_TOKEN from that change.

evidence.quote: npm granular access tokens (GATs) configured to bypass 2FA can no longer perform sensitive account, org, and package management actions.
This does not affect GitHub personal access tokens, GitHub App tokens, or GITHUB_TOKEN in Actions.

followUp.text: That follow-up still describes removal of direct publishing as a target for 2027-01. It does not report that later publishing restriction as completed.

evidence.quote: We are targeting January 2027 for this update.

evidence.quote: Dependency lifecycle scripts (i.e., preinstall , install , postinstall ) and implicit node-gyp builds no longer run unless explicitly allowed.
--allow-git defaults to none
--allow-remote defaults to none

claims.text: 같은 공지는 npm 2FA 우회 토큰의 민감한 관리 작업 제한을 2026-08 초로 예고했다. 직접 게시 제한은 별도 단계로 2027-01 무렵을 목표로 제시하며 신뢰 기반 게시·사람이 승인하는 단계적 게시로 전환하도록 안내했다.

evidence.quote: We expect this change to take effect in early August 2026.
We expect this change to take effect around January 2027.
move automated publishing to trusted publishing (OIDC) or staged publishing with a human approval step

followUp.text: 2026-07-31 후속 공지는 npm 2FA 우회 granular access token의 민감한 관리 작업을 제한하고 대화형 2FA 확인을 요구한다고 알린다. GitHub 개인 액세스 토큰·GitHub App 토큰·GITHUB_TOKEN은 해당 변경에서 명시적으로 제외한다.

evidence.quote: npm granular access tokens (GATs) configured to bypass 2FA can no longer perform sensitive account, org, and package management actions.
This does not affect GitHub personal access tokens, GitHub App tokens, or GITHUB_TOKEN in Actions.

followUp.text: 해당 후속 공지도 직접 게시 제거는 2027-01 목표로 설명한다. 후속 게시 제한이 완료되었다고 알린 것은 아니다.

evidence.quote: We are targeting January 2027 for this update.

reviewFocus.en: Verify enterprise ownership, component identity and dependency matching before rollout. An advisory or generated pull request does not itself deploy a fix; preserve review, testing and release controls.
reviewFocus.ko: 적용 전 기업 소유 범위·구성요소 식별·의존성 연결을 확인할 것을 제안합니다. 권고나 생성된 PR 자체가 수정을 배포하지는 않으므로 검토·테스트·릴리스 통제를 유지해야 합니다.

en.title: Innersource advisories: enterprise visibility and dependency remediation

claims.text: GitHub announced generally available internal security advisories for Advanced Security enterprise customers. Unlike public open-source advisories, their visibility is restricted to repositories owned by that enterprise.

evidence.quote: GitHub Advanced Security enterprise customers can now publish internal security advisories.
their visibility is restricted to repositories owned by the enterprise.

claims.text: The REST API supports creating, updating and withdrawing innersource vulnerabilities. After an advisory is created, Dependabot can notify internal repositories using the component and open an upgrade pull request when a fixed version is needed.

evidence.quote: including operations to create, update, or withdraw vulnerabilities.
Dependabot will open a pull request to upgrade a vulnerable version of the component to one with a fix.

their visibility is restricted to repositories owned by the enterprise.

evidence.quote: including operations to create, update, or withdraw vulnerabilities.
Dependabot will open a pull request to upgrade a vulnerable version of the component to one with a fix.

reviewFocus.en: Use the later notice for current eligibility and billing interpretation, while retaining the preview conditions as history. Advisory findings need a human response and do not replace required checks or comprehensive security validation.

en.title: AI code scanning: preview conditions and later general availability

claims.text: At preview launch, GitHub described AI detections on pull requests as extending language and framework coverage beyond CodeQL. Enterprise permission, organization enablement and repository CodeQL default analysis were required even though a separate AI engine performed the analysis.

evidence.quote: AI security detections must be allowed by your Enterprise policy and enabled at the organization level.
While CodeQL is not the tool performing the AI analysis, the AI detection engine relies on it to function.

claims.text: The preview findings were informational and did not block merges. The announcement required a Copilot license and consumed organization AI credits during public preview, so the original feature was neither an automatic approval gate nor an unconditional free service.

evidence.quote: These findings are informational and won’t block pull request merges.
During public preview, AI security detections require a GitHub Copilot license and draw down your organization’s AI credits.

followUp.text: GitHub’s 2026-10-15 notice announces AI Scan general availability. It says a Copilot license is not required; private and internal organization repositories still require GitHub Code Security or Advanced Security. These conditions differ from the preview announcement.

evidence.quote: Code scanning AI Scan for pull requests is now generally available.
A GitHub Copilot license is not required.
For private and internal organization-owned repositories, GitHub Code Security or GitHub Advanced Security is required.

followUp.text: The later notice retains advisory-only findings and says AI Scan cannot block merges through rulesets. It does not run on fork pull requests or pull requests created by Dependabot.

evidence.quote: They do not fail the code scanning check and cannot block pull request merges through ruleset requirements.
AI Scan does not run on pull requests from forks or pull requests created by Dependabot.

followUp.text: The later billing model consumes Code Security AI Credits, displayed under Advanced Security in enterprise AI usage. The absence of a Copilot-license requirement does not mean scanning has no usage charge.

evidence.quote: AI Scan for pull requests consumes Code Security AI Credits.

evidence.quote: AI security detections must be allowed by your Enterprise policy and enabled at the organization level.
While CodeQL is not the tool performing the AI analysis, the AI detection engine relies on it to function.

claims.text: 미리보기 발견 사항은 정보 제공용으로 병합을 막지 않았다. 공지는 공개 미리보기 중 Copilot 라이선스와 조직 AI 크레딧을 요구했으므로 자동 승인 관문이나 조건 없는 무료 서비스로 해석하면 안 된다.

evidence.quote: These findings are informational and won’t block pull request merges.
During public preview, AI security detections require a GitHub Copilot license and draw down your organization’s AI credits.

followUp.text: GitHub의 2026-10-15 공지는 AI Scan 정식 제공을 알린다. Copilot 라이선스는 필요하지 않지만 조직의 비공개·내부 저장소에는 GitHub Code Security 또는 Advanced Security가 필요하다고 설명한다. 미리보기 공지와 조건이 다르다.

evidence.quote: Code scanning AI Scan for pull requests is now generally available.
A GitHub Copilot license is not required.
For private and internal organization-owned repositories, GitHub Code Security or GitHub Advanced Security is required.

followUp.text: 후속 공지에서도 발견 사항은 권고용이며 AI Scan이 규칙 집합을 통해 병합을 막지 못한다고 설명한다. 포크 PR과 Dependabot이 만든 PR에서는 실행되지 않는다.

evidence.quote: They do not fail the code scanning check and cannot block pull request merges through ruleset requirements.
AI Scan does not run on pull requests from forks or pull requests created by Dependabot.

followUp.text: 후속 과금 모델은 Code Security AI Credits를 사용하며 기업 AI 사용량의 Advanced Security 제품으로 표시한다. Copilot 라이선스가 필요 없다는 설명을 사용량 요금도 없다는 뜻으로 해석하면 안 된다.

evidence.quote: AI Scan for pull requests consumes Code Security AI Credits.

reviewFocus.en: Confirm installed-app support and current plan terms, then validate each suggestion with tests and review. A clean AI review should not be treated as a security certification or a substitute for release controls.

en.title: Copilot app security review: preview scope and review limits

claims.text: The command complements code scanning, Dependabot and secret scanning with an on-demand local-change review. evidence.quote: It complements GitHub code scanning, Dependabot, and secret scanning
